rationale: The assistant guided the customer from filters to the condenser, which was the real cause, and the customer's test cycle confirmed the fix. No parts were recommended and the evidence was used well. Weaknesses: the first reply was garbled (truncated spin-speed item, filter cleaning said before condenser), the unplug reminder was repeated at the end, and the condenser step in the second turn lacked explicit removal and rinse instructions and an unplug reminder. The final message did not acknowledge the customer's vacuuming of the slot, and told them to reduce fabric softener, which was reasonable.
